name: design-for-ai
description: A design-foundations system for AI and developers — a multi-skill plugin where each design pillar is its own skill. Core (design-for-ai) owns the visual/aesthetic + surface layer (typography, color, composition, hierarchy, device-class patterns, motion, audit, enhance, polish). Eight pillar skills cover the rest: usability, content-design, data-viz, deceptive-patterns, behavioral, journey, design-systems, and ai-native. Each skill triggers on its own description and cites its principles; skills are auto-discovered from the skills/ directory.
